en_US-libritts-high.dataset: LibriTTS (Zen et al., 2019), derived from LibriSpeech and LibriVox
en_US-libritts-high.attribution:
Synthesised with Piper (https://github.com/rhasspy/piper, MIT) using the en_US-libritts-high model from rhasspy/piper-voices (https://huggingface.co/rhasspy/piper-voices, revision e9ab671f2a0e50a701b34361136ba3e6a3a9eb0c).
The model was trained on the LibriTTS corpus: Heiga Zen, Viet Dang, Rob Clark, Yu Zhang, Ron J. Weiss, Ye Jia, Zhifeng Chen and Yonghui Wu, "LibriTTS: A Corpus Derived from LibriSpeech for Text-to-Speech", Interspeech 2019, https://www.openslr.org/60/, licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). LibriTTS is derived from public domain audiobooks read by LibriVox volunteers (https://librivox.org).
The clips are synthetic speech generated from that model. They are not recordings of, and are not endorsed by, the LibriVox readers, the LibriTTS authors or the Piper project.
Speakers used (LibriTTS speaker ids): 3835, 5727, 6981, 7061, 7169, 7335, 7520, 7809, 8057, 8329, 8771, plus 3922 for the boxes Theme.
